test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

When I was a student, I used to visit the __library frequent.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the adverb form of "frequent." The correct adverb form is "frequently."
 
• Adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs and often end in "-ly."
 
• The correct phrase should be "visit the library frequently" to maintain grammatical accuracy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When I was a student, I used to visit the library frequently."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "library frequenter" **– This option is incorrect because "frequenter" is a noun and does not fit the context of the sentence where an adverb is needed.
 
• **Option 3: "No improvement" **– This option is incorrect because the original sentence is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 4: "library more frequent" **– This option is incorrect because it uses the comparative form "more frequent" incorrectly. The correct adverb form is "frequently."
